about_the_game:
About the Demo

The Expedition to Madness Demo lets you play solo or online with friends, with no time limits and unlimited replays. Earn experience, level up, collect wealth, and test all available equipment across two parallel dimensions.

  • Tutorial Dimension – Learn the core mechanics and gameplay loop in a safe environment.

  • UV01 Dimension – A full mission inspired by The Case of Charles Dexter Ward, H.P. Lovecraft’s iconic cosmic horror tale. Enter a Victorian nightmare twisted by interdimensional corruption.

Choose your gear, load the Hexeract, and dive into a terrifying co-op experience.

  • Perform forbidden rituals using the Necronomicon to open portals into the negative dimension and uncover alien artifacts.

  • Navigate a shifting world that constantly reshapes itself, don’t get lost.

  • Investigate which Outer God is influencing your expedition and unravel their hidden agenda.

  • Avoid temporal and spatial displacement. Stay close to your team or risk being trapped alone.

  • Solve ancient puzzles and recover rare relics for even greater rewards… if you make it back.

Explore. Extract. Escape. - Before the dimension consumes you.

About Expedition To Madness

Expedition to Madness is a 1–4 player co-op cosmic horror experience that blends survival, exploration, and psychological tension. Step into the boots of an inter-dimensional explorer on a desperate mission to find your missing partner, Emily, lost somewhere in the folds of reality.

EXPLORE

Traverse unstable wormholes into terrifying parallel dimensions inspired by Lovecraft’s most iconic stories. From the icy ruins of At the Mountains of Madness to the cursed coastlines of Innsmouth, each mission takes you deeper into a multiverse of horrors and hidden truths.

EXTRACT

Collect primordial energy, recover ancient artifacts, and piece together clues from Emily’s scattered journal. But be warned: unspeakable entities hunt in the dark, and the deeper you go, the harder it is to return.

ESCAPE

Survive the unknown. Maintain the wormhole. Discover what happened to her… and what lies beyond.

Key Features

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op: Venture alone or with up to 3 friends. Every run is unique.

  • Multiversal Horror Settings: Explore shifting dimensions based on Lovecraftian literature, fully rendered in atmospheric first-person.

  • Resource-Based Survival: Balance your energy consumption/gathering, and sanity as you extract primordial energy to avoid being trapped in the void forever.

  • Narrative Discovery: Uncover Emily’s fate through journal entries, strange phenomena, and clues across worlds.

  • Lovecraftian Enemies: Face creatures that defy logic, some you can run from, others you must challenge… or avoid entirely.

  • Persistent Progression: Sell primordial energy and alien artifacts to upgrade your equipment and unlock access to deeper, more dangerous dimensions.

  • Nonlinear Objectives: Choose how to explore, what to extract, and when to escape, if you still can.
